records.reviewer: Codex root visual comparison; not expert or examination-body certification
records.notes: Reviewed exact publisher glyph 玆 (U+7386), row 1223, for all ten strokes. Whole video 0–14.5s at 2fps; enlarged 5fps sequences 2.4–7s, 6.6–9.2s and 9.2–14.6s establish the bent strokes and direction. Times are sampled completed-by observations, not exact pen lifts. Left five strokes precede right five: descending-right dot, left-to-right bar, descending-left bend with a short rightward foot, longer descending-left bend with a right/upward base, then descending-right terminal. The right five strokes were checked independently against their own sequence, rather than approved by duplicating a component. All ten viewBox100 centerlines are separately authored from the whole-glyph comparison. No foreign glyph substitution or borrowed paths; authoredPathIndices 1–10 and sourceStrokeIndices all null. Source video and raster frames remain in RAM only. Compared every cumulative path with start/end markers and the enlarged final glyph at width 5. Extended output 8 short foot to meet output 9, as in the publisher image; retained the separated top bars and dots, the distinct left/right bodies, and both lower terminal joins. Approved output is a simple locally authored path animation. The publisher video is stroke-order evidence, not an upstream source of the path data and not examination-body certification. Evidence: docs/hanja-g3-batch5-followup5-2026-09-15/.
